test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Elegance and intelligence __had the__ two most important traits of young ladies.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about traits that are currently relevant and important, indicating the use of the present tense.
 
• The correct verb form to use in this context is **"are**" which matches the plural subject **"Elegance and intelligence."**
 
• Using the past tense verb "had" is incorrect, as it implies the traits were important only in the past.
 
• Other options like "has been" or "am being" do not align with the subject-verb agreement or sentence structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Elegance and intelligence **are **the two most important traits of young ladies."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "has been the" – Incorrect because it implies singularity, while the subject is plural.
 
• **Option 2:** "been the" – Incorrect because it lacks an auxiliary verb, making it grammatically incomplete.
 
• **Option 4:** "am being the" – Incorrect because it is inappropriate for the context and subject-verb agreement.
